finding: The old global mask validity accumulator rejected procedural nocked-arrow shaft/tip meshes whose valid PBR materials live in material_override rather than mesh.surface_get_material, and whose surfaces do not carry semantic COLOR masks.
resolution: Restrict semantic channel/white-RGB/anchor validation to the four authored moving shader domains; ordinary PBR surfaces do not need semantic colors. Independently reject the actual secondary shader on any unowned surface, including a deliberately injected moving shader on actual body skin. Preserve zero displacement on bow surfaces using that shader.
limits: No product source or asset defect identified by this failed assertion; final positive remains required.
